# Loadout Rank

> Ranked AI tools by use case (8 categories, 5 tools each) plus a dated list of recent AI releases. Scores are provisional editorial seed scores as of 2026-10-15.

Key facts: updated 2026-10-15; weights planned Quality 40 / Adoption 20 / Value 15 / Ease 15 / Trust 10; no affiliate or sponsored links currently.

## Main
- [Rankings (Markdown, citable)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/rankings.md): all rankings, scores, release list with dates and sources
- [Rankings (HTML)](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/): same data with per-category anchors
- [Methodology & disclosure](https://dlee8484.github.io/loadout-rank/about.html)
